span.label: method
span.quote: Thus, we propose to use continuousfilter convolutional layers to be able to model local correlations without requiring the data to lie on a grid.

span.label: modeling quantum interactions in molecules
span.quote: We apply those layers in SchNet: a novel deep learning architecture modeling quantum interactions in molecules.

span.label: system-or-tool-building
span.quote: We propose SchNet: a neural network specifically designed to respect essential quantumchemical constraints.

span.label: mechanisms

span.quote: their precise locations contain essential physical information, that would get lost if discretized

span.label: The radial-basis filter parameters (number and range of centres) were not systematically studied.
span.quote: An extensive evaluation of the impact of these variables is left for future work.

span.label: Training on forces roughly doubles the computational cost, because forces require a full forward and backward pass through the energy model.
span.quote: Due to the relation of energies and forces reflected in the model, we expect to see improved generalization, however, at a computational cost.

span.label: Performance on the new ISO17 benchmark, which combines chemical and conformational variation, is only promising rather than solved.
span.quote: While we achieve promising results on this new benchmark, modeling chemical and conformational variations remains difficult and needs further improvement.

span.label: A whole class of competing methods is excluded from force training by its REPRESENTATION - discrete binning and one-hot bond types - which makes their energy surface discontinuous.
span.quote: They can not be trained with forces in a similar manner, as they include discontinuities in their predicted potential energy surface caused by discrete binning or the use of one-hot encoded bond type information

span.label: The main benchmark contains only equilibrium molecules, where the force term the paper exists to predict is zero by definition.
span.quote: While QM9 only contains equilibrium molecules, for MD17 we predict conformational changes of molecular dynamics of single molecules. Finally, we present ISO17 combining both chemical and structural changes. For all datasets, we report mean absolute errors in kcal/mol for the energies and in kcal/mol/Å for the forces. The architecture of the network was fixed after an evaluation on the MD17 data sets for benzene and ethanol (see supplement). In each experiment, we split the data into a training set of given size N and use a validation set of 1,000 examples for early stopping. The remaining data is used as test set. All models are trained with SGD using the ADAM optimizer [39] with 32 molecules per mini-batch. We use an initial learning rate of 10−3 and an exponential learning rate decay with ratio 0.96 every 100,000 steps. The model used for testing is obtained using an exponential moving average over weights with decay rate 0.99. 5.1 QM9 – chemical degrees of freedom QM9 is a widely used benchmark for the prediction of various molecular properties in equilibrium [10, 40, 41]. Therefore, the forces are zero by definition and do not need to be predicted

span.label: A named competitor is ruled out of one benchmark entirely, and its scaling behaviour is given as quadratic in both atoms and examples.
span.quote: However, GDML does not scale well due to its kernel matrix growing quadratically with the number of atoms as well as the number of examples

span.label: deep convolutional neural networks applied to model quantum interactions in molecules
span.quote: Deep learning has the potential to revolutionize quantum chemistry

span.label: the invariances - BY CONSTRUCTION, not measured: rotational equivariance of the forces follows from rotational invariance of the energy plus the architecture, so it is a guarantee rather than an empirical result, and must not be compared with a model's measured conservation
span.quote: As SchNet yields rotationally invariant energy predictions, the force predictions are rotationally equivariant by construction

span.label: QM9 - AS A BENCHMARK OF THE SPECIAL CASE: equilibrium molecules only, which is precisely where the forces vanish, so the benchmark omits the regime the architecture was built for
span.quote: Models such as circular fingerprints [17], molecular graph convolutions or message-passing neural networks[21] for property prediction across chemical compound space are only concerned with equilibrium molecules, i.e., the special case where the forces are vanishing

span.label: the filter - CONTINUOUS RATHER THAN DISCRETE, because atom positions do not lie on a grid and their precise locations carry physical information that discretising destroys
span.quote: Instead, their precise locations contain essential physical information, that would get lost if discretized
